parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description:
The number of the page to return.

Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of storage plans to return on each page.

Valid values: 1 to 100.

Default value: 10.

parameters.name: UseUTCDateTime
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the time to return is in UTC.

Valid values:

*   true (default): returns UTC time.
*   false: returns UNIX timestamp.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun nas describe-storage-packages --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --page-size 10 --use-utc-date-time true --page-number 1 --region cn-hangzhou
